Lina (Docs): Heads-up PR #4987 is red in preview: several console samples are failing during render. stack trace points to the dashboard snippet that still uses `cost_breakdown.v1` field.
Noah (Eng-Obs): ugh, we renamed that field to `cost.metrics` in the v2 telemetry schema last sprint. i thought docs had a migration ticket.
Ravi (SDK): we changed the SDK helper to accept both names but the example snippets in the docs repo weren't updated. i'll push a tiny change to the examples folder.
Lina (Docs): can you also add a short note in the migration guide that shows a one-line sed command? saves copy/paste for customers.
Ravi (SDK): sure. proposed snippet: ```bash
# replace old cost field in dashboard yaml
sed -i 's/cost_breakdown.v1/cost.metrics/g' dashboard.yaml
```
Bea (Platform): when you update the snippet, can you also remove the legacy redirect in /_redirects that points to /console/obsv/legacy-cost? it's confusing and shows up in sidebar search.
Noah (Eng-Obs): i'll open a tiny PR to remove the redirect and add a note to the changelog. no breaking runtime changes expected since compat shim exists.
ci-bot: PR 4987 preview: render-error in docs site (snippet runtime exception)
Oscar (QA): after the example patch, i'll run the quick smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/playground -d '{"sample":"dashboard-cost"}'` and paste the response.
Ravi (SDK): PR 4990 opened with updates to examples + migration snippet. also added a one-line comment in node/python examples showing fallback to `oldCost` env var for older deployments.
Lina (Docs): nice. i also found two internal links that still reference `/console/observability/cost-breakdown` (old path). can we sweep and make them relative? small linkfix PR would be great.
Noah (Eng-Obs): doing a repo-wide grep and will push linkfix in the same PR as the redirect removal.
Oscar (QA): smoke after mergers: `HTTP 200` and preview inspector shows `{"cost":{"metrics":{"cpu":12,"gpu":3}}}` and no stack traces.
Lina (Docs): merging once CI green. leaving a follow-up to add a short note in the release notes about the field rename and links removed. thanks team :heart:
